findings.location: blockchain-core/spec.md: Genesis block initialization vs configuration/spec.md: Genesis block data
findings.trigger_condition: Genesis block field values contradict across two specs
findings.guard_snippet: Reconcile canonical genesis fields; pick one definition and reference it from both specs.
findings.potential_consequence: Two incompatible genesis definitions means a peer chain is rejected as invalid genesis, breaking sync.

findings.trigger_condition: Requirement ends with unimplemented placeholder instead of testable behavior
findings.guard_snippet: Remove (implementation pending); define calculateBalance() returns big.js(balance)+big.js(stake); add asserting scenario.
findings.potential_consequence: Requirement has no verifiable scenario; a build can satisfy the spec while returning anything.

findings.location: transaction-miner/spec.md: Mining empty pool vs blockchain-core/spec.md: Empty block rejected after bootstrap
findings.trigger_condition: Miner must create reward-only blocks but validation rejects them at height > 3
findings.guard_snippet: Resolve contradiction: miner must not create reward-only blocks when height > 3, or define bootstrap rule precisely.
findings.potential_consequence: Miner produces a block peers and the local validator reject; pool is cleared of included txs, chain degrades.

findings.location: transaction-system/spec.md: Stake validation vs configuration/spec.md: Minimum stake amount
findings.trigger_condition: Stake rules form impossible region: amount >= 200 AND <= 10% of balance
findings.guard_snippet: Define feasible region; e.g. require balance >= 2000 or apply constraints to different operations; state balance < 2000 behavior.
findings.potential_consequence: For any balance below 2000 no stake transaction can ever be valid; staking unreachable for low-balance accounts.

findings.location: api-endpoints/spec.md: Fee auto-calculated vs electron-app/spec.md: Create transaction vs renderer-ui/spec.md: Transaction submission
findings.trigger_condition: Conflicting fee models: auto amount/1000 vs user-supplied vs omitted
findings.guard_snippet: Decide single fee source of truth; align all three specs and their scenarios.
findings.potential_consequence: Implementation cannot satisfy all three; user fee violates enforced floor or auto-calc discards user input.

findings.location: electron-app/spec.md: Get blockchain vs api-endpoints/spec.md: Paginated block retrieval
findings.trigger_condition: Pagination described two ways: offset/limit vs path /api/blocks/:id
findings.guard_snippet: Specify one pagination contract and map or remove the other.
findings.potential_consequence: API cannot implement both shapes; client calling one shape gets undefined results.

findings.location: transaction-system/spec.md: Reward validation vs blockchain-core/spec.md: Block mining
findings.trigger_condition: Reward crediting mechanics undefined for reward-only transaction
findings.guard_snippet: Define how 100-coin reward reaches miner (special mint credited to miner account) and document it.
findings.potential_consequence: Naive application makes miner lose 100 coins and an unrelated account gain them, inverting incentives.

findings.trigger_condition: No key backup, recovery, or seed/phrase requirement; only single-file persistence
findings.guard_snippet: Add key-recovery requirement and failure behavior when ~/.succinctcoin/wallet is corrupted or missing.
findings.potential_consequence: Only key copy is one local file with no backup; single point of irreversible fund loss.

findings.location: configuration/spec.md: Network configuration vs p2p-networking/spec.md: discv5/relay
findings.trigger_condition: p2p references DISCV5_BOOTSTRAP_ENRs and RELAY_ENDPOINTS with no config definition
findings.guard_snippet: Add configuration requirements for DISCV5_BOOTSTRAP_ENRs, RELAY_ENDPOINTS, and the 30s search-interval default.
findings.potential_consequence: Networking depends on undefined configuration; malformed env var has no specified handling.

findings.location: api-endpoints/spec.md: Create transaction vs transaction-system/spec.md: Transaction structure
findings.trigger_condition: Amounts arrive as JSON numbers but money must be big.js integer/string
findings.guard_snippet: Add requirement validating and converting amount to big.js integer, rejecting unsafe values, never float arithmetic.
findings.potential_consequence: JSON numbers through big.js/JS float paths risk precision loss, corrupting balances and fees.

findings.location: account-management/spec.md: Stake operations vs wallet/spec.md: Create stake transaction
findings.trigger_condition: Stake transaction fee handling undefined
findings.guard_snippet: Define whether fee is charged in addition to stake and whether addStake deducts the fee; add validation scenario.
findings.potential_consequence: Fee and stake balance adjustments inconsistent; staking can double-deduct or under-deduct.

findings.trigger_condition: Hash determinism only specified for string inputs, but blocks/transactions are objects
findings.guard_snippet: Define recursive key sort for objects and add scenarios hashing a block/transaction object.
findings.potential_consequence: Object hashing depends on insertion/key order; identical blocks produce different hashes, breaking signatures and chain validation.

findings.location: p2p-networking/spec.md: Receive transaction from peer vs transaction-system/spec.md: Prevent duplicate sender transactions
findings.trigger_condition: Receiving a peer transaction always adds it; dedup only specified for local adds
findings.guard_snippet: Apply same duplicate-sender dedup to peer transactions, or explicitly allow them until block validation rejects.
findings.potential_consequence: Buggy/malicious peers can flood the pool with duplicate-sender transactions local validation would reject.

findings.location: api-endpoints/spec.md: Root state synchronization vs p2p-networking/spec.md: Chain replacement
findings.trigger_condition: Two chain-sync mechanisms with no precedence: root sync vs peer replaceChain
findings.guard_snippet: Define precedence/interaction between root-node sync and peer consensus; define ROOT_NODE_ADDRESS in dev (self-sync).
findings.potential_consequence: Conflicting or simultaneous chain updates cause races, flip-flop chains, or self-sync replacing local chain.

findings.location: crypto-utils/spec.md: Signature verification vs wallet/spec.md: Transaction signing
findings.trigger_condition: Signature serialization format unspecified (hex/DER/length-prefixed)
findings.guard_snippet: Specify exact signature encoding for both transaction and block signatures; add sign/verify round-trip scenarios.
findings.potential_consequence: Block and transaction signing use different serializations; signatures verify intermittently and get rejected.

findings.trigger_condition: Only HTTP 400 specified; other failure modes undefined
findings.guard_snippet: Define status codes/bodies for non-400 failures (500, 401/403 no-wallet) and api.init() dependency failures.
findings.potential_consequence: Unhandled failure paths return undefined responses or crash the server in the common unavailable-dependency case.

findings.trigger_condition: subtractBalance/addBalance with negative amount
findings.guard_snippet: Add non-negative amount guard to balance operations.
findings.potential_consequence: balance increases instead of decreasing, inflating funds.

findings.trigger_condition: addStake when balance < amount; subtractStake with negative amount
findings.guard_snippet: Verify balance >= amount on addStake; add non-negative guard on subtractStake.
findings.potential_consequence: balance goes negative; stake exceeds actual funds.

findings.trigger_condition: POST /api/transact with amount 0/negative or missing recipient
findings.guard_snippet: Validate amount > 0 and recipient present before creating transaction.
findings.potential_consequence: zero/negative-value transaction created and broadcast.

findings.trigger_condition: GET /api/blocks with page id 0 or negative
findings.guard_snippet: Clamp page id 0/negative to valid range or return defined error.
findings.potential_consequence: empty array returned silently for invalid page.

findings.trigger_condition: syncWithRootState when root fetch fails or times out
findings.guard_snippet: Wrap root fetch in try/catch; keep local state on failure.
findings.potential_consequence: local chain or pool overwritten with empty data.

findings.trigger_condition: fee = amount/1000 when amount is big.js string
findings.guard_snippet: Perform fee division in big.js, not JS number.
findings.potential_consequence: fee precision lost for large amounts.

findings.trigger_condition: Two specs define different canonical genesis blocks
findings.guard_snippet: Reconcile blockchain-core vs configuration genesis constants.
findings.potential_consequence: cross-spec validation rejects the other's genesis.

findings.trigger_condition: Mining empty pool creates reward-only block at height > 3
findings.guard_snippet: Miner must respect the empty-block rule when height > 3.
findings.potential_consequence: self-mined empty block rejected by network.

findings.trigger_condition: Incoming chain same length as local but invalid
findings.guard_snippet: Compare not just length but also local validity.
findings.potential_consequence: stuck with invalid equal-length local chain.

findings.trigger_condition: verifySignature with malformed or null signature
findings.guard_snippet: Return false on malformed/null signature, not throw.
findings.potential_consequence: throws exception instead of returning false.

findings.trigger_condition: Crypto.hash called with no arguments
findings.guard_snippet: Define behavior for empty inputs.
findings.potential_consequence: hashes empty string, returns unexpected digest.

findings.trigger_condition: blockchain pubsub message malformed or unparseable
findings.guard_snippet: Wrap parse/replaceChain in error handling.
findings.potential_consequence: handler throws and peer processing crashes.

findings.trigger_condition: transaction pubsub message from peer malformed
findings.guard_snippet: Validate message shape before adding to pool.
findings.potential_consequence: malformed transaction crashes pool handler.

findings.trigger_condition: chain length is 0 (empty chain)
findings.guard_snippet: Handle Math.ceil(0/5)=0 by rendering a disabled/placeholder page.
findings.potential_consequence: no page navigation buttons rendered at all.

findings.trigger_condition: block hash shorter than 15 characters
findings.guard_snippet: Guard truncation against hash length.
findings.potential_consequence: short hash shown with trailing ellipsis oddly.

findings.trigger_condition: sender/recipient hash shorter than 30 characters
findings.guard_snippet: Guard truncation against hash length.
findings.potential_consequence: short hashes shown with trailing ellipsis oddly.

findings.trigger_condition: form submitted with empty or non-numeric amount
findings.guard_snippet: Add client-side amount validation before POST.
findings.potential_consequence: invalid amount POSTed to transact endpoint.

findings.location: renderer-ui/spec.md: Wallet info loaded via IPC
findings.trigger_condition: account object missing balance field on load
findings.guard_snippet: Check for undefined/NaN before rendering balance.
findings.potential_consequence: UI shows undefined or NaN balance.

findings.trigger_condition: transaction with amount exactly 0 or negative
findings.guard_snippet: Reject amount <= 0 explicitly.
findings.potential_consequence: zero-value passes validation; negative inflates recipient balance.

findings.trigger_condition: normal transfer whose recipient equals a special address
findings.guard_snippet: Ensure special-recipient routing still runs fee and balance checks.
findings.potential_consequence: transfers to special addresses bypass validation.

findings.trigger_condition: stake amount at or near exactly 10% of balance
findings.guard_snippet: Perform 10% comparison in big.js, not float.
findings.potential_consequence: boundary stake misjudged by float error.

findings.trigger_condition: second transaction from an existing sender arrives
findings.guard_snippet: Define whether existingTransaction replaces or rejects the duplicate.
findings.potential_consequence: duplicate or silently dropped sender transaction.

findings.trigger_condition: setMap called with null or undefined map
findings.guard_snippet: Add null/undefined check on setMap.
findings.potential_consequence: pool set to invalid or corrupt state.

findings.trigger_condition: wallet file on disk corrupted or partial
findings.guard_snippet: Add corruption handling when restoring wallet.
findings.potential_consequence: wallet fails to load and app may crash.
